source.asset_origin: Repository-authored vector simplification of the textual design; not recovered Gemini artwork.

bible.characters: Little Shrew is one warm-brown bean with tan snout, pink triangle nose, six straight whiskers and one curved tail. Mama and Papa are larger copies; three siblings are smaller copies. All six survive safely. No costumes or changing anatomy.
bible.world: Fictional prehistoric burrow, protected root pocket and clearing. Dinosaur stays offscreen; show only the footprint. No historical or biological precision claims.
bible.visual_style: Flat SVG geometry, fixed palette, thick dark outline. One shared rig, four expressions: sleepy, neutral, surprised, happy. No fur, gradients, shading, teeth, eye highlights, extra limbs or camera orbit. Slide, bounce and tilt only. Static side view except final wider framing. Keep six whiskers and proportions unchanged.

music.brief: Original gentle instrumental nursery rhythm, 120 BPM. Soft flute, light percussion and restrained nonverbal foley. No speech or sung lyrics. Quiet after the gentle impact. No copied melody or recording.

beats.title: Cozy family
beats.action: Little Shrew naps in the burrow with Mama, Papa and three baby siblings.

beats.title: A lovely smell
beats.action: Little Shrew sniffs a root sprout and rolls into a snug side pocket.

beats.title: A gentle rumble
beats.action: Pebbles bounce. Mama and Papa notice the ground shaking.

beats.title: Time to move
beats.action: A little dirt falls; the family moves toward safe hiding places.

beats.title: Everyone takes shelter
beats.action: Mama and Papa guide all three babies down the deep tunnel. Little Shrew backs into the protected root pocket under a rock ledge.

beats.title: A giant step
beats.action: An unseen dinosaur steps above. Soft brown dust fills the old path; everyone remains sheltered safely.

beats.title: Daylight returns
beats.action: Dust clears in a breeze. Little Shrew peeks out and blinks in the daylight.

beats.title: Follow the smell
beats.action: Little Shrew sneezes dust off its whiskers, then sniffs the family trail.

beats.title: One enormous footprint
beats.action: A wider view reveals a giant three-toed footprint. Little Shrew smiles and does a four-beat wiggle before following the family trail.

segments.title: Notice with your senses
segments.learning_objective: Notice smells and gentle vibrations in a fictional story.
segments.activity: Pretend to sniff a flower, then gently tap your knees.
segments.start_state: The family rests together in the burrow.

segments.title: Find a safe place
segments.learning_objective: Notice the family moving together to shelter.
segments.activity: Point to the safe tunnel with a grown-up.
segments.end_state: The family is safe in the deep tunnel; Little Shrew is safe in the root pocket.

segments.title: Small and big
segments.learning_objective: Compare the small character with the large footprint.
segments.activity: Make a small shape and then a big shape with your hands.
segments.start_state: The family is safe in the deep tunnel; Little Shrew is safe in the root pocket.
segments.end_state: Little Shrew follows the family scent trail; reunion is the next story.
